title: Can Language Models Understand mmWave Data? Benchmarking Large Language Models for mmWave Radar-Based Human Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2608.14179v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable reasoning and generative capabilities, motivating their use as universal reasoning engines for perception. While modern approaches such as vision-language models (VLMs) have attempted to incorporate reasoning capabilities into visual sensing, the integration of LLMs with the millimeter-wave (mmWave) modality-despite its unique advantages under low light and occlusion-remains largely unexplored. The principal bottlenecks stem from the scarcity of radar language pairs, severe cross-dataset heterogeneity, and the absence of a foundational mmWave encoder. We address this gap through a minimal textualization interface that serializes each mmWave point cloud into concise natural language, allowing off-the-shelf LLMs to operate in a question answering (QA) setting. Building on this, we present mmWave-QA, the first benchmark for language-conditioned mmWave human perception. mmWave-QA aggregates

translated_title: 语言模型能理解毫米波数据吗？——针对毫米波雷达人体理解的大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）展现了卓越的推理和生成能力，这促使它们被用作感知任务的通用推理引擎。虽然现代方法如视觉语言模型（VLMs）已尝试将推理能力融入视觉感知，但将LLMs与毫米波（mmWave）模态相结合——尽管其在低光照和遮挡条件下具有独特优势——仍基本未被探索。主要瓶颈源于雷达-语言配对的稀缺性、跨数据集严重异质性以及缺乏基础毫米波编码器。我们通过一个最小化文本化接口解决了这一差距，该接口将每个毫米波点云序列化为简洁的自然语言，使现成的LLMs能在问答（QA）设置中运行。在此基础上，我们提出了mmWave-QA，这是首个面向语言条件化毫米波人体感知的基准测试。mmWave-QA汇集了...
tldr: 本文首次提出mmWave-QA基准，通过将毫米波点云转化为自然语言的文本化接口，使现成大语言模型能够理解毫米波雷达数据，解决了雷达-语言配对稀缺和缺乏基础编码器的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces mmWave-QA, the first benchmark for language-conditioned mmWave human perception, using a minimal textualization interface that converts mmWave point clouds into natural language, enabling off-the-shelf LLMs to understand radar data despite scarce radar-language pairs and lack of foundational encoders.
